signatures.description: Implement the HPACK header-compression codec from RFC 7541: decode a stream of header blocks against the static table and a dynamic table that grows and evicts FIFO entries (entry size = name+value+32) on size updates. Support indexed, literal-with-incremental-indexing, literal-never-indexed and literal-without-indexing representations, and validate Huffman-decoded strings for EOS-padding and overlong-padding errors. Given a sequence of encoded blocks, output the exact decoded field lists in order plus the final dynamic table contents and its byte size.
